ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the fly life cycle. At the top is the adult fly, labeled A; on the right is a small cluster of white eggs, labeled D; at the bottom are several worm-like larvae, labeled B; on the left is a pupa-like structure, labeled C. Arrows connect the stages in the direction of the life cycle. Reasoning: The question asks what stage comes immediately after the Eggs stage. In the figure, Eggs are the white egg cluster on the right labeled D. Following the arrow leaving this stage downward and to the left, the next stage is the worm-like form at the bottom labeled B, namely Larvae.
